name: OpenCLI
description: Site adapters + Browser Bridge on your logged-in Chrome via OpenCLI. Requires a local opencli install. Ships disabled.

agent.prompt: Prefer OpenCLI for logged-in websites and known site adapters. Pipeline: (1) doctor if unsure setup (2) list or run site commands with --json when available (3) for ad-hoc pages use browser with a session name (e.g. work): open → state → click/type/fill/extract. Do NOT also drive the same Chrome with Computer Use Ghost CDP in the same turn. Desktop/non-Chrome apps stay on Computer Use.
